name: TuAsistenteconIA
author: canaia

sections.description:
Integrate TuAsistenteconIA virtual assistants into your page to automate customer service. Your visitors get instant answers about products, policies, and purchasing processes, without you having to be constantly available. One-click connection: log into your TuAsistenteconIA account, select your assistant, and you’re all set. Customize the appearance from the TuAsistenteconIA platform. The chat works 24/7, improving conversions and reducing repetitive inquiries that consume your time.

Features:

  • Seamless integration with TuAsistenteconIA accounts.
  • Enable or disable the support chat with a single click.
  • Lightweight and easy to use.
  • Fully compatible with the latest version of WordPress.

Support

For support, please visit our support page or contact us at contacto@canaia.ai.

Terms of Use

sections.faq:
1. Do I need a TuAsistenteconIA account to use this plugin?

Yes, you must have an active TuAsistenteconIA account to connect and use the support chat feature.

2. How do I connect my TuAsistenteconIA account?

After activating the plugin, you will see a configuration window asking you to connect your TuAsistenteconIA account and select your assistant. Follow the instructions to complete the setup.

3. Is this plugin free?

The plugin is free to download and use. However, you will need an active TuAsistenteconIA subscription to use the assistants.
